rules.milestoneIntervals: Slayer_reward_point: 'bonus points are awarded after every 10th, 50th, 100th, 250th, and 1,000th completed task. For example, completing 20 tasks in a row awards bonus points on both the 10th and the 20th consecutive tasks.' and '5x points every 10th task / 15x points every 50th task / 25x points every 100th task / 35x points every 250th task / 50x points every 1,000th task'
rules.milestoneOrder: NOT EXPLICITLY STATED on any fetched page. Every per-master table lists a single value per interval (e.g. Konar 'Every 100th 450'), and Slayer_reward_point says the average over a 1000-task streak is '1.775x the base points' / '44,375 points' for Krystilia, which is consistent with the highest applicable multiplier replacing (not stacking with) the lower ones, but no sentence says so. Treat as unknown.
rules.pointsStart: Slayer_reward_point: 'Slayer points are not awarded for the first four tasks a player completes but are rewarded for their fifth and further tasks.' Krystilia: 'players will have to complete five of her Slayer assignments to begin earning Slayer reward points.'
rules.turaelReset: Slayer_Master '===Slayer points===' (Turael): 'Completion of a task assigned by Turael will not grant any Slayer points. As well, if it was a task replacing one from another Master your task streak will be reset. So, if you're on the 48th task and take a replacement one from Turael, your completed tasks will be set to 0.' Turael page: 'Warning: After a task change is processed, your task streak will also be reset to zero!' Slayer_reward_point table: 'This will reset the player's task streak to zero, and the player will have to complete four more tasks to begin earning points again. Tasks assigned by Turael/Spria give no points but do contribute to the four needed to start gaining points.'
rules.turaelCannotReplace: Slayer_Master: 'this only works if the assignment is something that he doesn't assign. For example, if Chaeldar assigns a player Desert Lizards, then the Burthorpe Slayer Master cannot change their task, as he too assigns Desert Lizards. Note that it is impossible for a player to get Turael to reassign a task that he gave out.' Turael page: 'Tasks may be blocked at Turael to remove them from his list of assignments, allowing them to be changed if assigned by other Slayer masters.' Spria page: 'players cannot skip Spria's tasks using Turael.' Mortimer page: 'Mortimer's tasks cannot be skipped by receiving a replacement assignment from Turael.'
rules.turaelSkipKrystilia: Slayer_reward_point: 'A task from Krystilia that is changed by Turael will only reset your Wilderness Slayer task streak.'
rules.otherStreakResets: Slayer_Master Notes: 'If a player becomes ineligible to receive their existing Slayer task, they can cancel it for free without losing their streak by speaking to a Slayer Master.' Krystilia page: 'If the player chooses to reset an assignment Krystilia gives before the five assignments are completed, the counter will reset to zero'. Slayer page (partner): 'If a player hasn't killed at least 20% of the monsters on their task, they will not receive any reward points and their task will not count towards their streak.' No other reset cause found.
rules.skipCost: Slayer page: 'players may cancel a task by spending 30 points.' Slayer Rewards page Tasks table: 'Cancel task | 30-100 | Cancels the player's current assignment without penalties.' Mortimer: 'skipping a task from Mortimer is significantly more expensive, costing 100 slayer points rather than the usual 30'.
rules.blockSlots: Slayer Rewards page: 'There is a maximum limit of 7 types of assignments that can be blocked on one account - one block slot is given for every 50 quest points the player has. For most slayer masters - with Mortimer being the exception - there are six slots for a total of 300 points needed to use all of them. Additionally, one block slot is available once the player has completed the Elite tier of the Lumbridge & Draynor Diary, which requires a quest cape. In Mortimer's case, there are two block slots available.' Also: 'Blocking a task that is currently in Task Storage does not also skip it.' 'Cancelling the removal of monsters ... does not refund points'.
rules.blockLists: Slayer Rewards changes 27 Aug 2025: each master has own block list; 'Shared block lists only apply to Turael, Aya and Spria'. Costs: Turael/Aya/Spria 40, Mazchna/Achtryn 50, Vannaka 60, Chaeldar 70, Konar 80, Nieve/Steve 90, Duradel/Kuradal 100, Krystilia 100; Mortimer 120 (Slayer_Master table).
rules.capeBypass: Slayer_Master table footnote: 'The combat level requirements can be bypassed by achieving 99 Slayer and showing the Slayer Master the Slayer cape.' Slayer_cape: 'Showing the cape to a master also bypasses combat level restrictions on tasks for lower-levelled accounts.' Changes 1 Oct 2025: 'Slayer Masters will now respect combat level, if enabled, even with a Slayer cape equipped.' Duradel/Kuradal/Mortimer pages explicitly say the cape substitutes for the combat req (Slayer level req still applies).
rules.pointsCap: No cap on points found on any fetched page (searched Slayer, Slayer_reward_point, Slayer_task, Slayer Rewards for 'cap', 'maximum', '65,535'). Only related note: streak change 1 Mar 2023: 'Players with a slayer task streak of 16,000 will no longer receive the max amount of slayer points for every task'. Unknown.
rules.spending: Slayer_reward_point '==Rewards==': 'Slayer reward points can be spent to extend or block tasks, to purchase items useful for Slayer tasks, and on several unlocks such as automatic finishing blows, crafting Slayer equipment, and unlocking new tasks.' Totals: 'A total of 11,580 points are required in order to obtain all the rewards and blocks at least once ... Excluding the slayer helmet recolours reduces this to 3,580 points'. Buy examples (Slayer Rewards page): Slayer ring (8) 75, Broad bolts x250 35, Broad arrows x250 35, Herb sack 750, Rune pouch 750, Looting bag 10. Unlock examples cited on Konar/Krystilia pages: Like a boss 200, Watch the birdie 80, Basilocked 80, Reptile got ripped 75, Seeing red 50, Actual Vampyre Slayer 80, Warped Reality 60, Task Storage 500 (reduced from 1000, 27 Aug 2025), Ring Bling 150, Bigger and Badder 50, Slug Salter 10, Reptile Freezer 10, Pedal to the Metals 200.
rules.partnerSlayer: Slayer page: 'Task streaks are counted individually for each player, and milestone bonuses are seperated from the regular reward points on partner tasks. For example, completing an assignment from Duradel as the 10th slayer task in a row normally grants you 75 reward points if done alone. If done with a partner, you'll instead receive 60 points as a streak bonus and up to 15 points from the shared task.' (i.e. milestone bonus = milestone value minus base).
rules.runeliteCounters: RuneLite SlayerPlugin.java (~line 679): streak = SLAYER_WILDERNESS_TASKS_COMPLETED for KRYSTILIA_SLAYER_MASTER, VarPlayerID.SLAYER_MORTIMER_TASKS_COMPLETED for MORTIMER_SLAYER_MASTER, else VarbitID.SLAYER_TASKS_COMPLETED; points = VarbitID.SLAYER_POINTS.

unknowns: Milestone precedence when several intervals coincide (e.g. task 100 = 10th+50th+100th) is not stated in words on any fetched page
